| colspan="2" | Enemy gauntlet in the [[Far Fields#Skull Cave|Skull Cave]]. Requires [[Clawline]]. Hornet begins the gauntlet by striking the explosive Flintflame in the arena. Doing so breaks the floor and leaves 2 platforms floating on lava. Once Hornet defeats the penultimate wave, the lava begins to rise, which can kill the enemies in the Final wave.

If Hornet, an enemy, or a projectile touches a platform, it is destroyed temporarily. If Hornet falls into the lava, she is transported onto an additional temporary platform in the very centre.
